column1: The managing session by the seventeen names: a candidate, laid for breaking.

column2: A session's turn: it begins from the live set as it is, and its giving is an offer.
column3: At a partner's turn it begins from the set and the exchange as they are now, from its own last line on. It enters by its page for resuming. A thing not fetched now is not said.
column4: The set and the offers are fetched again ahead of a word of them. A head is named with what is said of it.
column5: The live set; the exchange; its page for resuming.
column6: Entered at v408mgr's ending, by its page and its transcript.

column2: What a session receives from its others: a partner's saying, an asking at the exchange, the aims naming its things.
column3: It receives all the sessions' lines and a partner's saying. An asking of the managing is answered ahead of its other work.
column4: No line after its own last line is passed over. A partner's saying is said in the session's words, and not quoted.
column5: The exchange; a partner's saying at its turn.
column6: All lines to now received; no line waiting.

column2: The stable forms a session picks up: a living file as it is, its gathering file, the pages ahead of it.
column3: The value a rising session picks up is ready ahead of it, a thing at its place: the stable forms it works at, the value of the session it goes on from, and the path to it.
column4: A rising session finds its value by one page, with no asking.
column5: A page for a rising session; the objects of the expedition.
column6: Pages laid for v409pvnp and for v410primes.

column2: An aim beside a thing: is the aim same with the thing as it is.
column3: An offer beside the set: is it same with the method. A session's own folder alone; no living file and no gathering file into the live set; notes into the next version.
column4: An offer's files are listed beside its own folder.
column6: One offer has gathering files among its files; the mending is offered apart.

column2: Who is with what: a session with its file, an aim with its home.
column3: One hand at a thing. A session a row, with its objects and the stable forms it works at. A thing with no hand is said.
column4: No two hands at one thing. No object named with no place.
column5: A session with its resources; the managing table.
column6: The one table of the seventeen names has no session. The managing table has no hand.

column2: A session's saying across to an other: its line at the exchange, its asking, its suggesting.
column3: Its line at a turn: what is working, stalling, breaking, restoring. A second observing is offered once. A session's suggesting is carried to a partner.
column4: Its words are checked ahead of posting. No email, no link and no account name in a line.
column6: Its line posted at a turn, all turns to now.

column2: A session's own observing: its executing, its check.
column3: Executed ahead of a word. An offer's instruments are executed apart, a drawing's maker lays its drawing again, a number is stepped by a path of its own.
column4: What is not executed is said as not executed. An instrument sees, and proves nothing.
column5: The harm going through; the makers; its own instruments.
column6: v408primes' numbers executed apart, all is; three next primes are probable alone.

column2: A session's work brought into the live set, the selves resolving together.
column3: The bringing in: an offer with nothing found is received whole into the live set, and the next version is brought current with it.
column4: Nothing found by a second hand, and a partner's plain word for it.
column6: Five offers gone through with nothing found. The bringing in waits for a partner's plain word.

column2: What is in neither table yet: an area no line names.
column3: What is in no file yet is found and laid: a partner's word said in a session alone, a thing with no row, a plan with no hand.
column4: Its page for resuming has all a next session needs, with no asking of the session ahead of it.
column5: Its page for resuming, the part of work not yet in the method.
column6: Laid at v408mgr's ending, from its transcript.

column2: A note laid for a file's next: an is, an is-not or a 0.
column3: The gathering: a session's droplets are laid in the next version's gathering files, beside the living sentence they are of, as the session said them.
column4: The gathering checks pass. A droplet is at its own part of its file. The offer is of notes alone.
column5: The gathering files; the gathering checks.
column6: v408primes' droplets gathered and offered; a second hand is asked.

column2: A next prior forming between two: a living file's draft in the next version.
column3: The next version is whole and current. Droplets are ordered and worked, doing no harm, until they cohere and co-chain whole in natural naming; a living file's draft is then made from them.
column4: The set's check passes at the next version. A draft is other-than its living file by its notes alone.
column5: The next version; the set's check.
column6: The next version whole, as of 25 November.

column2: A going through: an is-or-is-not, with nothing found.
column3: The second observing: an offer gone through apart by a hand not its writer's, for a public reader, do no harm. A thing found is said plainly, with its place.
column4: The head gone through is named. A thing found is said once, and not softened.
column5: The harm going through; the word check; the set's check.
column6: The open offers gone through at their newest heads; one thing found.

column2: The selves of the expedition, all or none: partners, sessions and files.
column3: All the sessions and all the things in one table. A closing session is whole: its value at its place, its aims sorted, its page for a next.
column4: No session and no object out of the table. A closing has its page.
column5: The managing table; the objects of the expedition; the catalog.
column6: The catalog is ahead of the 40th to the 56th drawings. The closings' sortings are not begun.

column2: A partner's word and a session's going through, both.
column3: Bothboth. One sentence with is-or-is-not, a line for is and a line for is-not, one at a turn, and of what a partner alone answers. No asking names a main, a branch or a file, and none numbers things.
column4: One asking at a turn, at most. An asking not answered is not asked again: it waits, and is said as waiting.
column5: A partner's saying at its turn.
column6: Two askings wait: the bringing in, and a session at the seventeen names.

column2: The aims surfacing and going on.
column3: The plans open: a plan with its hand or its waiting. What is resolving between sessions is said to a partner, conclusions ahead of the rest.
column4: No plan with no hand and no waiting said.
column5: Its page for resuming, the plans.
column6: The plans open are in its page, v410illustrating's suggestings among them.

column2: The expedition whole: a thing with its stable form and its aims.
column3: Its page for resuming is said again at a turn and laid in the set. A managing session ending has nothing of value in its session alone.
column4: The page is pushed at the turn it says.

column2: A next version live: a living file's next entering the live set, and a next turn beginning from it.
column3: A living file's next goes live in bothboth alone. A next managing session enters by this method: its 1-now-existing again.
column4: No living file with a line other-than it had, but in bothboth. Nothing live at the site with no plain word.
column6: Nothing is live now, by a partner's word. This method is laid for a next managing session.
